facts.business: HDB Financial Services Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company - Upper Layer (NBFC-UL) providing retail finance for commercial equipment, commercial vehicles, personal loans, enterprise loans, and BPO services including sales support, back office operations, and collection call centres.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure (including net CWIP) - Lending business
Capital Expenditure (including net CWIP) - BPO Services

key_risks: Global economic uncertainties and geopolitical tensions
Trade and policy pressures transmitting into financial markets
Strong US dollar tightening financial conditions in emerging markets
Limited fiscal headroom with global public debt at around 94% of GDP
Significant judgement and estimates in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) model under Ind AS 109
Data inputs completeness and accuracy for ECL model
Model estimations for Probabilities of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD) and Exposures at Default (EAD)
Economic scenarios determination and probability weighting for forward-looking ECL measurement
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions with HDFC Bank Limited (holding company) and other group entities include bank charges, back office support services, sales support services, BBPS charges, corporate logo license fees, dividend paid, ASBA commission, and interest paid on non-convertible debentures. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest during FY 2025-26.
